description: The single currently selected research arm

description: Candidate direction; not a FIFO queue item

description: Positive valid signal merits deeper investigation

name: research:high-priority
description: High expected information gain or urgent blocker

name: research:low-priority
description: Preserve but do not select without new evidence

name: research:blocked
description: Blocked by a named prerequisite or external dependency

name: research:metric-risk
description: Metric, evaluator, or comparison is not yet trustworthy

description: Requires an explicit human decision before continuing

name: research:harness-gap
description: Research contract or automation lacks a needed guard

name: research:hold
description: Global program hold; no autonomous selection or execution

name: research:postmortem
description: Negative result or discontinued branch has durable lessons

name: research:gpu-authorized
description: Human-reviewed arm may request future GPU authority; not launch permission
